 * This module is the single seam between the UI and a future
 * ERP / product-database integration. Every screen reads products,
 * brands and categories through the functions at the bottom of this
 * file — swap those implementations for API calls and nothing else
 * in the app needs to change.
 */

export type Availability = "in-stock" | "limited" | "special-order";

  label: string;
  value: string;
}

  slug: string;
  name: string;
  manufacturer: string;
  mfrPartNumber: string;
  pickrelSku: string;
  category: string;

  description: string;

/**
 * Selling prices come from the pricing engine (product cost basis x the
 * markup that applies to the current visitor / account). The static catalog
 * below is product marketing data only — never a source of truth for price.
 */
export interface PriceOverride {
  price: number | null;
  uom?: string | null;
  availability?: string | null;
  mfrPartNumber?: string | null;
  pickrelSku?: string | null;
}

export function applyPriceOverrides(overrides: Record<string, PriceOverride>): void {
  for (const p of PRODUCTS) {
    const o = overrides[p.slug];
    if (!o) continue;
    p.price = o.price;
    if (o.uom) p.uom = o.uom;
    if (o.availability) p.availability = o.availability as Availability;
    if (o.mfrPartNumber) p.mfrPartNumber = o.mfrPartNumber;
    if (o.pickrelSku) p.pickrelSku = o.pickrelSku;
  }
}

export function getAllProducts(): Product[] {
  return PRODUCTS;
}

export function getProductBySlug(slug: string): Product | undefined {
  return PRODUCTS.find((p) => p.slug === slug);
}

export function getProductsBySlugs(slugs: string[]): Product[] {
  return slugs.map(getProductBySlug).filter((p): p is Product => Boolean(p));
}

export function searchProducts(query: string, products: Product[] = PRODUCTS): Product[] {
  const q = query.trim().toLowerCase();
  if (!q) return products;
  const terms = q.split(/\s+/);
  return products
    .map((p) => {
      const haystack = [
        p.name,
        p.manufacturer,
        p.mfrPartNumber,
        p.pickrelSku,
        p.category,
        p.subcategory,
        p.shortDescription,
        p.description,
        ...p.keywords,
      ]
        .join(" ")
        .toLowerCase();
      const score = terms.reduce((acc, t) => (haystack.includes(t) ? acc + 1 : acc), 0);
      return { p, score };
    })
    .filter((r) => r.score > 0)
    .sort((a, b) => b.score - a.score)
    .map((r) => r.p);
}

/** Facet values available for the given product set, category-aware by design. */
export function buildFacets(products: Product[]): Record<string, string[]> {
  const out: Record<string, Set<string>> = {};
  for (const p of products) {
    for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(p.facets)) {
      (out[k] ??= new Set()).add(v);
    }
  }
  return Object.fromEntries(
    Object.entries(out)
      .map(([k, v]) => [k, [...v].sort()] as const)
      .sort((a, b) => a[0].localeCompare(b[0])),
  );
}

export const AVAILABILITY_LABEL: Record<Availability, string> = {
  "in-stock": "In stock — Dayton warehouse",
  limited: "Limited stock — call to confirm",
  "special-order": "Special order — typically 3-5 days",
};

export function formatPrice(price: number | null): string {
  if (price === null) return "Call for pricing";
  return price.toLocaleString("en-US", { style: "currency", currency: "USD" });
}
